@{5fca5df4d58780532024a52b|full_name}: Yeah that's correct (Read it while testing it with PhysicsBones). Idk if this also works for sync to the server or if thats just 'local' for example to be sync with OSC for another application (to see if something is triggered or being grapped). 
It couldn't find any options with this. But 128 what JCity said 18 is pretty much limited.

Just having variable sized ints would help a lot already, since I'm often using ints to swap between maybe 5 - 10 different options, which could easily fit into 3 or 4 bits as well. Considering a variable number of bools are already supported, bit alignment doesn't seem to be a problem, so please allow us to have anything from 2 to 8 bit integers.

To add to this i'd love to see an increase to the update rate of parameters. My face tracking is currently limited to 4hz because of OSC's update rate.
I don't get why they give you so little parameters, it's extremely limiting and especially with the avatar dynamics beta and OSC stuff you're going to run out extremely quickly.
